sources.title: ISO/IEC 82304-2 — health software quality & safety
sources.why: Its safety and use-related risk requirements govern non-device apps users may over-rely on when the software fails or misleads.

sources.title: PLD — Product Liability Directive (software & AI)
sources.why: It makes software liable for harm, which is exactly what occurs when users over-rely on a defective or failing system.
